Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry from self-serve signup

Hi Laura,

We just completed a self-serve trial and our infra team asked me to get a short walkthrough of Redwood's Dedicated offering focused on throughput and p99 latency. We're evaluating a real-time inference stream where 95% of requests are <= 64 tokens but we have occasional bursts of long contexts (800-1,024 tokens) from batch reranks. Key ask: can you show how Dedicated handles mixed sequence lengths, autoscale behavior under 10k qps-ish bursts, and what observability we get for tail latency?

We're on PACIFIC time — myself and Priya (ops) are available 6/15 or 6/16 afternoon PT. If you have a short checklist we can load beforehand, that would help speed the call.

Cheers,
Alex Chen
Director, Infrastructure
Helium Analytics

--
